text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You're so obvious when you're feeling
down.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ayabe?! Oh no, you heard all that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Sighing all by yourself on the swings...
Could you
get any more cliché?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well... I'm taking a break from being a
big sister
right now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You are? I guess nothing's impossible.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My little twin sisters got in a big fight
because of
me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And apparently they haven't talked for
three days
now! I can't even believe it...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
To make things worse, my mom told me
not to
text them because they're still
sensitive about it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What happened?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Helios gave me this weird-looking
keychain, so I
decided to send it back
home.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And they got into a fight over it...
It was
this
cutesy bobble head of Fujin the
wind god.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you just laugh?! I heard that,
Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That wasn't a laugh. I'm just relieved.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
They probably wanted it because it
shares your
name. That just shows how
much they like you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?! So that's what's this is about?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Your sisters are really proud of you, so
what's the
reason for you to feel down?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right! I feel better
already!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, look at me coming to you for
comfort.
Ayabe, you're like a real big
sister.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't be crazy. I'm nowhere near your
level.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Treasure your sisters, okay?
